reason: A DSH web interface appearance plugin that imports local and Wallpaper Engine media, renders wallpapers, and provides extensive background, blur, transparency, color, and rotation controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面加载本地及 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸，并提供背景、虚化、透明度、主题色和轮换设置。
summaries.en: Loads local and Wallpaper Engine wallpapers into the DeepSeek Harness web interface with controls for backgrounds, blur, transparency, theme colors, and rotation.

capabilities: Reads and parses user-selected local wallpaper files and directories
Loads video, image, GIF, and Wallpaper Engine MPKG content as backgrounds
Loads HTML wallpapers in a sandboxed iframe
Modifies background, blur, transparency, color, scaling, and rotation settings
Can use user-provided image URLs and offers plugin update checks
